data.one_liner: A Flutter widget providing pull-down refresh and pull-up load for all scrollable widgets.
data.what_it_does: EasyRefresh provides customizable pull-down refresh and pull-up load features for Flutter scrollable widgets. It integrates various styles of Headers and Footers with built-in physics and animation support.
use_when: You need pull-to-refresh or infinite scrolling on scrollable widgets.
You require custom animations and styles for your headers and footers.
You are using Flutter >= 3.47 with material_ui and cupertino_ui.
avoid_when: Your app is still using the standard package:flutter/material.dart instead of material_ui.
You do not need list refresh or load functionalities.
strengths: Supports almost all Flutter scrollable widgets and NestedScrollView.
Integrates multiple built-in headers and footers with custom styling support.
Provides fine-grained controller methods and physics control.
weaknesses: Requires migration to material_ui and cupertino_ui for version 4.0+.
Complex nested layouts (like NestedScrollView) require specific integration recipes.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter >= 3.47 and Dart ^3.13, along with material_ui and cupertino_ui packages.
data.minimal_example:
EasyRefresh(
  onRefresh: () async {},
  onLoad: () async {},
  child: ListView(),
)
